  the API is read-only
  ok    allow  research/agent  GET https://api.example.com/v1/items

  ok    allow  research/agent  GET https://unclaimed.example.org/
  ok    deny   research/agent  POST https://api.example.com/v1/items
  ok    deny   research/agent  GET https://api.example.com/v1/../admin
  ok    deny   research/agent  GET https://user@api.example.com/v1/items
  files are audited, not enforced
  ok    allow  research/agent  GET https://files.example.com/public/a.txt
  ok    audit  research/agent  GET https://files.example.com/private/a.txt
  ok    audit  research/agent  GET https://files.example.com/public/%2e%2e/private
  ok    allow  billing/agent  GET https://files.example.com/private/a.txt
